title: Cross-Probe Ordering of the Multi-History Saturation Orbit
status: RAW RESPONSE-STRENGTH ORDER REJECTED; WITHIN-VIEW SATURATION-DISTANCE ORDER CLOSED ACROSS ALL H/O VIEWS
ruling: History depth does not monotonically increase raw response magnitude; that scalar is rejected. However, for every fixed H/O probe view, normalized Euclidean distance to the saturated E16 readout decreases monotonically across the entire controlled orbit. This defines a probe-family order of convergence rather than a universal scalar clock. Together with E044/E045 it separates topographic basin entry from continued microstate relaxation inside the basin.
